log.text: Season 1, day 1. The new moon is 7 days off. Anyone who dies inside the walls wakes at dusk as a shade.
The masons raise a Barracks on top of the keep. By night its twin, the Watch of the Dead, is the Tain's deepest room.
The masons raise a Chapel on top of the keep. By night its twin, the Choir of Echoes, is the Tain's deepest room.
Tam died of old age. Nell grieves.
Dusk. 1 body lies in the crypt. Hold funerals or let them wake.
Tam wakes Serene in the Hall hand mirror.
Night 1. 6 Creepers will come before dawn.
A Weeper rises for the day's dead in the Cold Hearth. In the dark there it gives the sleepers nightmares.
A Weeper has wept its fill in the Cold Hearth and sinks away. Someone asleep above will wake from a nightmare.
A Creeper has caught Hesper in the dark of the Choir of Echoes.
A Creeper has caught Hesper in the dark of the Choir of Echoes.
A Creeper has caught Hesper in the dark of the Choir of Echoes.
Nightmares: 1, in the Hearth. Ada works at 60% today.
Dawn. The Unlit withdraw and the shades go back into the glass. Decide who stays.
Dread 0 → 2.
Corra (adult) arrives at the gate and asks to stay. Assign a job.
Spring of year 1, day 2.
The masons raise a Chandlery on top of the keep. By night its twin, the Wick Room, is the Tain's deepest room.
Raiders on the road: 3 of the Ashen Host, strength 5.1. Your defense is 5.8.
The Host is at the gate: 3 raiders, strength 5.1, against your defense of 5.8. The gate should hold. Pitch, stone and the bell can turn it.
The Host fell back from the gate.
One raider fell inside the gatehouse. The body lies in the crypt.
Dusk. 1 body lies in the crypt. Hold funerals or let them wake.
Kolt was burned with the Host's dead.
Night 2. 8 Creepers will come before dawn.
Dawn. The Unlit withdraw and the shades go back into the glass. Decide who stays.
The Chapel pier glass is covered. Garrick is released.
Dread 2 → 3.
Spring of year 1, day 3.
Dusk. Set the candles and post the shades.
Night 3. 11 Creepers will come before dawn.
The Unlit seep up in the Wick Room. It has no candle.
The Unlit seep up in the Wick Room. It has no candle.

Word comes from the Lantern Church: an inspector will visit tomorrow at noon and judge how the keep keeps its dead.
Vale (adult) arrives at the gate and asks to stay. Assign a job.

Fire in the Hearth! Everyone in it fights it; send the Yard to help, or it will spread and kill.
Ada run from the Yard to fight the fire in the Hearth.
Raiders on the road: 3 of the Ashen Host, strength 6.8. Your defense is 3.3.
The gate is warded with essence: defense +4.

The fire in the Hearth is out.
